# Charter

## Goal

Explain how the run store keeps state safe.

## Context

The owner reads it before a review.

## Deliverable

One explainer page.

## Phases

- research
- design

## Quality bar

A newcomer can say why each write is atomic.

## Invariants

- I1: Every claim cites a file.
- I2: The page uses no internal names.

## Personas

- reviewer (blocking): Checks each claim against the code.
  - sources: skills/source/cli
  - phases: research, design
- reader (advisory): Reads the page as a newcomer.
  - sources: none
  - phases: design

## Page

https://example.com/source/run

## Grants

- publish the page (words u1)
